  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Porsche Marin is proud to present this beautifully specified 2025 Porsche Macan, a luxury compact SUV that perfectly combines Porsche performance, premium comfort, and everyday practicality. Finished in elegant Dolomite Silver Metallic over a Black interior, this Macan offers a timeless and sophisticated configuration with an impressive list of desirable factory options.

Equipped with Porsches renowned PDK automatic transmission, the Macan delivers smooth power delivery, responsive handling, and the engaging driving dynamics that define the Porsche brand. Its balanced chassis and refined ride quality make it equally capable for spirited driving and daily commuting.

This example is enhanced by the Premium Package Plus, adding a range of luxury and convenience features designed to elevate every drive. The exterior is complemented by LED headlights with Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS+), providing exceptional visibility and a distinctive appearance, while colored Porsche crest wheel center caps add an elegant finishing touch.

Inside, the cabin is thoughtfully appointed with 14-way power seats with memory, ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, and a heated steering wheel, ensuring exceptional comfort for both driver and passengers. An electric steering column further enhances convenience and personalization.

Technology and driver assistance features are seamlessly integrated throughout the vehicle. The BOSE Surround Sound System delivers premium audio performance, while Surround View provides added confidence and ease when maneuvering in tight spaces. Lane Change Assist (LCA) enhances safety and awareness on the road, complementing the Macans driver-focused design.

A panoramic roof system adds an open and airy atmosphere to the cabin, further elevating the luxurious feel of the interior and enhancing the overall driving experience.

With its refined specification, premium comfort features, and unmistakable Porsche driving character, this 2025 Porsche Macan represents an outstanding opportunity to own one of the most versatile and engaging luxury SUVs in its class.

For more information or to schedule a private viewing, please contact lcouncil@porschemarin.com or visit us in person.

Conquer the rugged Texas backroads without leaving a single luxury behind. This 2023 Ford Expedition Timberline is a One-Owner, Clean CARFAX recent arrival that boasts a New Price structural dropmaking it an exceptional value. Finished in a sleek Silver Metallic with an upgraded Black Onyx Leather interior, the Timberline trim is a heavy-duty, off-road specialist built with a high-output Raptor-sourced heart and premium Equipment Group 501A High Package amenities.

High-Output Raptor Power & Off-Road Armor
The Timberline isn't just a styling package, it's the most capable off-road factory Expedition ever built, heavily upgraded with hardware borrowed from the F-150 Raptor.

3.5L V6 EcoBoost High-Output Engine: Blasting out a monstrous 440 horsepower and 510 lb-ft of torque. This out-muscles the standard Expedition and provides immediate acceleration.

Off-Road Chasis & Clearance: Features rough-road suspension, a wider track, and a massive 10.6 inches of ground clearance alongside heavy-duty underbody skid plates borrowed from the F-150 Raptor.

Trail Turn Assist: Can lock the inside rear wheel to drastically reduce the turning radius, letting you maneuver this full-size SUV tightly around tight trail obstacles.

Equipment Group 501A High Package Luxuries
The 501A High Package elevates the off-road monster's interior into a premium executive mobile office.

15.5" LCD Capacitive Touchscreen: The massive, vertically oriented center display running SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition and connected navigation.

B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen: A rich, multi-speaker studio surround system delivering pristine high-fidelity audio tailored to the cabin's layout.

Panoramic Vista Roof: A sweeping dual-pane glass roof that stretches across the first two rows, letting in plenty of natural Texas light.

Heated & Ventilated Leather Captain's Chairs: Keeps the driver and front passenger perfectly temperature-regulated, paired with Heated 2nd-Row Power-Folding Captain's Chairs for elite rear passenger comfort.

Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package
Ready to pull your massive boat, horse trailer, or camper across the country with total confidence.

Pro Trailer Backup Assist: Allows you to steer your trailer backwards effortlessly using a simple control knob on the dashboard while the system manages the steering wheel.

Integrated Trailer Brake Controller: Provides seamless, modulated braking power to your trailer's axles in perfect sync with the Expedition.

Smart Convenience & Proactive Safety
Power Liftgate & Autofold Mirrors: Provide effortless cargo loading and auto-folding side mirrors when you lock the vehicle in tight parking spots.

Ambient Lighting & Digital Instrument Cluster: Sets a sophisticated mood inside the cabin while displaying vital travel stats in clean, high-resolution graphics.

Rain-Sensing Wipers & Brake Assist: Proactive driving assists that maximize visibility and stopping power when sudden Central Texas rainstorms strike.

The Covert Commitment
Serving Central Texas and beyond since 1909, the Covert family has spent over a century building an impeccable legacy of trust, integrity, and client satisfaction. Visit us at 11750 Research Blvd, Austin, TX to experience the "Covert Commitment" firsthand and see why this high-output 2023 Expedition Timberline is the definitive choice for the ultimate family adventure.
